using Pragmatic.Validation;

namespace TestNamespace;

public partial record ChangePasswordRequest : ISyncValidator
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Validates this instance and returns a ValidationError.
    /// </summary>
    /// <returns>A ValidationError with IsSuccess=true if valid, or IsFailure=true with issues if invalid.</returns>
    public ValidationError Validate()
    {
        var error = ValidationError.Valid;
        
        // Validate NewPassword
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(NewPassword))
        {
            error = error.WithFor(nameof(NewPassword), "validation.required");
        }
        
        // Validate ConfirmPassword
        if (!Equals(ConfirmPassword, NewPassword))

            error = error.WithFor(nameof(ConfirmPassword), "validation.equalto", ("other", nameof(NewPassword)));
        }
        
        return error;
